source_refs.note: 3. Bioaccumulation and Magnification: a main subheading of 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 255-255.

blocks.text: Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification pani ki pollution ke serious adverse effects (sangeen bure asraat) hain: mercury, lead aur pesticides jaise toxic substances (zehreele maadde) waqt ke saath jandaron ke jism mein jama hote jate hain (bioaccumulation). Food chain mein har qadam oopar jate hue in zehron ki concentration barhti jati hai (biomagnification). Is liye sab se oopar ke shikari (top predators), insan samet, aksar sab se zyada miqdar (dose) lete hain.

blocks.alt: Barhti oonchai ke paanch dabbe teeron se jure: pani, plankton, chhoti machhli, bari machhli, aur insan samet oopar ke shikari. Mercury, lead ya pesticide jaise zehr ke surkh nuqte baen se daen har dabbe mein barhte jate hain.
blocks.caption: Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Har janwar apne neeche ke bohat se jandaar khata aur zehr ko nikalne ke bajaye jama karta hai, is liye food chain ke har qadam par concentration barhta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se daen food chain mein oopar jaate hain: pani → plankton → chhoti machhli → bari machhli → top predators (insan samet). Har dabbe mein surkh nuqte (zehr) zyada hote jaate hain, kyunke har jaandaar apni khuraak ka zehr apne jism mein jama karta hai aur woh bahar nahi nikalta. Is liye sab se oopar wale ko sab se zyada dose milti hai.
